translation: It treats mouth sores, eye pain, brightens the eyes, and frees the nine orifices; bamboo shoot (竹筍), flavor sweet, not poisonous; chiefly treats wasting-thirst, benefits the waterway, boosts qi, and can be eaten long-term. Dried shoot, burned and taken, treats the five hemorrhoids with blood. Original text of the Benjing: Bamboo leaf (竹葉), flavor [pungent/generic]
